name: Vashu Bhagnani Industries Limited
about: Vashu Bhagnani Industries Limited engages in the film production and other related activities in India and internationally. The company co-produces and produces films; exploits and distributes films through music release, theatrical distribution, television licensing, and other new media distribution avenues; and develops a multi-storey premium residential project at Juhu under the POOJA LUMINAIRE brand. It also provides production management; marketing strategies and promotional campaigns, including trailers, advertising, and public relations; and licensing and distribution rights for theaters, TV, digital platforms, and overseas markets. The company was formerly known as Pooja Entertainment and Films Limited and changed its name to Vashu Bhagnani Industries Limited in March 2024. Vashu Bhagnani Industries Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Mumbai, India.
